assertions.title: File uploads work for source bundles and WASM artifacts

steps.action: Submit the Source Bundle Upload form for proj_7961 with sample-source-bundle.zip and source ref fh-panels-round5-src-03151158.
steps.expected: The form enters an uploading state, then shows success copy, resets cleanly, and does not surface the old inline reset error.
steps.observed: The browser flow completed to the visible success copy 'Bundle accepted. Build bld_96edfd4307aca8573945a7c1 is in pending.'; afterward the source form reset to project='', sourceRef='main', sourceKind='zip', and neither the uploads panel text nor browser errors contained the old reset exception.

steps.action: Submit the Prebuilt WASM Artifact form for proj_7961 with sample-app.wasm and source ref fh-panels-round5-art-03151158.
steps.expected: The form enters an uploading state, then shows success copy and resets cleanly without surfacing the old reset error.
steps.observed: The visible success copy was 'Artifact ready: bld_42c816e90b1732674a1d59e6 (wasm/wasi-command / stdout-bridge)'; afterward the artifact form reset to project='', sourceRef='upload', declaredRuntime='', and no inline reset error or console error appeared.

steps.action: Corroborate the resulting upload builds through the API.
steps.expected: Both uploads persist as real build records for the isolated project.
steps.observed: GET /api/v1/builds?projectId=proj_7961 returned bld_96edfd4307aca8573945a7c1 as built/prebuilt_wasm for sourceRef fh-panels-round5-src-03151158 and bld_42c816e90b1732674a1d59e6 as built/uploaded_artifact for sourceRef fh-panels-round5-art-03151158.

evidence.consoleErrors: none; browser errors returned {} after the successful upload checks, and the uploads panel text did not contain the old reset exception
evidence.network: GET /api/v1/builds?projectId=proj_7961 -> bld_96edfd4307aca8573945a7c1 (built, prebuilt_wasm, provider upload, sourceKind zip, runtimeMode stdout-bridge) and bld_42c816e90b1732674a1d59e6 (built, uploaded_artifact, provider upload, runtimeMode stdout-bridge).

assertions.title: Deployment creation and listing works

steps.action: Select proj_7961 and built artifact bld_96edfd4307aca8573945a7c1, then submit a preview deployment with target ref fh-panels-round5-preview-03151158 and runtime env ROUND5=1.
steps.expected: The deployment form shows an in-flight state and then renders a result card with deployment ID, status, domain, reachable endpoint link, and resource profile; the deployment should become reachable if runtime infrastructure is ready.
steps.observed: The UI rendered a Deployment Created result card for dep_0e548d8946f17ceb51483cf8 with status starting, launch mode stdout-bridge, domain fh-panels-round5-96b7fe82e5d8u2-03151158-1.janus.run, resource profile CPU 250m / RAM 512MB / Disk 1024MB, and the visible placeholder 'Waiting for runtime endpoint...'.

steps.action: Inspect the newly listed deployment in the panel.
steps.expected: The new deployment appears in the list with a reachable endpoint or at least progresses toward one.
steps.observed: The deployment card appeared immediately with dep_0e548d8946f17ceb51483cf8, status starting, target preview / fh-panels-round5-preview-03151158, Reachable Endpoint 'Not available yet', and a View Logs action.

steps.action: Poll the deployment and domain records through the real API to determine whether runtime access is available or still deferred.
steps.expected: If runtime infrastructure is ready, the deployment reaches running with a non-empty runtime endpoint; otherwise it remains runtime-blocked and should be classified blocked rather than fail.
steps.observed: Repeated GET /api/v1/deployments?projectId=proj_7961 and GET /api/v1/domains?projectId=proj_7961 polls over ~50 seconds kept the deployment/domain in status starting with runtimeEndpoint null/empty and no error message; the records then disappeared from both filtered listings without ever producing a reachable endpoint. This indicates the frontend form/listing path is working, but runtime access is still deferred to the dedicated e2e-deployment-access validation surface.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed during deployment form submission or deployment-panel inspection
evidence.network: UI create rendered dep_0e548d8946f17ceb51483cf8 / fh-panels-round5-96b7fe82e5d8u2-03151158-1.janus.run. API polling for ~50s: GET /api/v1/deployments?projectId=proj_7961 -> status starting with runtimeEndpoint null; GET /api/v1/domains?projectId=proj_7961 -> deploymentStatus starting with runtimeEndpoint ''. The deployment never became reachable and then disappeared from both filtered API listings, matching a runtime/infrastructure defer rather than a frontend-only regression.

assertions.issues: Blocked by runtime infrastructure: the deployment creation UI succeeded and produced a real deployment/domain shell, but runtime access never materialized, so VAL-FH-018 remains deferred to e2e-deployment-access rather than failing as a frontend regression.

assertions.title: Log modal displays, filters, and exports logs

steps.action: Open View Logs for build bld_96edfd4307aca8573945a7c1 from the project-filtered Builds panel.
steps.expected: A modal opens and shows the Loading logs... state before the log lines render.
steps.observed: The build log modal opened for 'Build Logs - bld_96edfd4307aca8573945a7c1'; a loading-state screenshot was captured before the settled modal rendered 8 visible lines and the built status summary.

steps.action: Exercise severity filters and auto update.
steps.expected: All, Errors, Warnings, Info, and Success update the visible-count chip, and Auto update can be toggled off.
steps.observed: The Errors and Warnings filters reduced the modal to Visible: 0, Info and Success each reduced it to Visible: 1, All restored Visible: 8, and the Auto update checkbox became unchecked (false).

steps.expected: Copy succeeds with user-visible confirmation, Download saves the visible logs, and Close dismisses the modal.
steps.observed: Clicking Copy changed the button label to 'Copied!' with no clipboard permission error, Download saved the log export, and Close dismissed the modal so [role=dialog] count returned 0.

evidence.consoleErrors: none; browser errors remained empty after clearing the log before Copy, and the modal reported a user-visible success state ('Copied!') instead of a clipboard denial
evidence.network: GET /api/v1/builds/bld_96edfd4307aca8573945a7c1/logs returned 8 lines that matched the modal body; Download saved those lines to frontend-hardening/dashboard-panels-round5-rerun/downloads/VAL-FH-020-bld_96edfd4307aca8573945a7c1-all.log.

frictions.description: The assigned agent-browser session became unreadable after the initial authenticated redirect until the session was restarted in headed mode and the auth cookie was reapplied from the API session-exchange flow.
frictions.resolution: Killed only the assigned 96b7fe82e5d8__u2 daemon, relaunched the same session in headed mode, and reused the isolated account's janus_access cookie from the local curl.exe session-exchange cookie jar.

frictions.description: A few screenshot reads timed out during very brief in-flight re-render windows for upload/deploy actions even though the post-submit states loaded correctly.
frictions.resolution: Used the successful post-submit screenshots plus targeted text/API reads to capture the final UI state and corroborate the resulting backend records.

blockers.description: Runtime access for the isolated deployment never became available: dep_0e548d8946f17ceb51483cf8 stayed starting with no runtime endpoint, and its domain binding fh-panels-round5-96b7fe82e5d8u2-03151158-1.janus.run also had an empty runtimeEndpoint before both records disappeared from the filtered API listings.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Waited/polled GET /api/v1/deployments?projectId=proj_7961 and GET /api/v1/domains?projectId=proj_7961 for ~50 seconds after UI creation; the deployment never exposed a reachable endpoint, so the blocker remains runtime-side and should stay deferred to e2e-deployment-access.

summary: Tested 3 assigned dashboard rerun assertions: 2 passed (VAL-FH-016 uploads, VAL-FH-020 log modal) and 1 is blocked (VAL-FH-018 deployment access still depends on missing/deferred runtime infrastructure). Strongest evidence: the old upload reset error is gone while both upload flows now create built records and reset cleanly; the log modal now reaches a real 'Copied!' success state and downloads logs; deployment creation produces a real deployment/domain shell but never a reachable runtime endpoint.
